strings.name: Luiza Trajano
strings.summary: Trajano rose from sales in her relatives’ shop to leading Magazine Luiza in 1991, promoting physical and digital retail. She co-founded Mulheres do Brasil and backed women’s leadership, domestic-violence support and racial inclusion. A 2026 interview confirmed her continuing board leadership. Published birth years conflict: 1948 and 1951.
